components.basis: The rule sheet for classical propositional tableaux (sheet:tableaux-cpl, registry/calculi/tableaux-cpl.tex, rendered on the compiled route by showcalculus at classical-and-constructive-calculi.tex line 204) displays the expansion rules for and, not-and, or, not-or, implication, not-implication and double negation with their linear/branching retention-and-marking side conditions (lines 12-18) and the closure rule with branch and tableau closure (line 19; closure conditions also in the identity, line 11). The same system and domain (full primitive language bottom, not, and, or, implies) is kept, and the sheet's rules match the body table (w02-p02-014 lines 66-94). The sheet also carries the systematic-completeness statement and countermodel read-off of the acceptance clause (line 11). Not an unmatched old artifact: the sheet is the current registry file linked to current labels. The mapped catalog file parts/p14/rule-sheets.tex (line 14 also shows the sheet) is not input anywhere and is not counted as evidence; the on-route rendering is classical-and-constructive-calculi.tex line 204.

The sheet identity (tableaux-cpl.tex line 11) defines retained occurrences with metalinguistic expansion marks, open and closed branches, saturation (every expandable occurrence marked), the expandable occurrences (exactly the seven premise shapes, so p, not-p, bottom and not-bottom are terminal and never need a mark) and finished tableaux (each branch closed or saturated), linked to def:p02-w02-p02-014-expandable, where the same terminology is defined for the body (w02-p02-014 lines 66-79, 103-118, 129-133) and in def:p02-cpl-tableau (propositional-hilbert-tableaux 136-142).

The sheet identity (tableaux-cpl.tex line 11) states systematic completeness (expanding in any order terminates in a finished tableau, and a finished tableau is closed iff its root is unsatisfiable) and the countermodel read-off (an open saturated branch gives the valuation true exactly at the variables on it, which satisfies every formula on the branch and hence the root), linked to thm:p02-w02-p02-014-termination, thm:p02-w02-p02-014-completeness, thm:p02-w02-p02-014-truth, thm:p02-w02-p02-014-soundness, thm:p02-tableau-adequacy and thm:p02-w02-p02-014-decision. Those results are stated in the body (w02-p02-014 lines 174-265) with written annex proofs (annex lines 97-273), and the systematic procedure is def:p02-w02-p02-014-procedure (236-253). The on-route chapter text before the sheet repeats the pointer (classical-and-constructive-calculi.tex 197-202).
